Terms of Service

Effective November 17, 2026

1. What this site is

WorthIt Goods publishes price tracking, comparisons, and deal roundups compiled from publicly available retailer listings. It is an independent informational service. It is not a store: we never sell products, process payments, or fulfill orders. Purchases happen on the retailer's own site under the retailer's own terms.

2. Prices and availability

Listed prices reflect what we observed at the last refresh (up to 24 hours old) and change without notice at the retailer's discretion. Before buying, confirm the live price on the retailer page linked from the listing. We do not guarantee completeness or timeliness of any data point, and we correct verified errors on request and at the next daily build.

Affiliate links

Some outbound links are affiliate links; see our affiliate disclosure. Commissions never determine rankings or displayed prices.

3. Acceptable use

  • Do not scrape or bulk-download our datasets without written permission — the paid API (chipradar.io/api) exists for that.
  • Do not republish our comparisons as your own; citation with a link back is welcome.
  • Do not abuse the newsletter (one-click unsubscribe at any time; we honor it immediately).

4. No warranty / liability

Service is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, WorthIt Goods is not liable for decisions made using this site's data or for third-party site content. Our recommendations are informational, not professional advice.

5. Your data

Newsletter emails are handled per our privacy policy: the address and nothing else, used only to send the newsletter, deletable on request.

6. Changes & contact

Material changes get a date bump and a newsletter notice. Questions about these terms: contact us — we reply within two business days.
